source_structure: Two complete Greek knee MRI reports, first right then left, each with technique, findings and conclusion, separated by the literal bilateral note. This is explicit opposite-knee report aggregation, not mere compartment terminology or temporal comparison.
order: Full original sources independently read and frozen before neutral images; every displayed sample personally viewed before other assessor source/header/visual conclusions for this package. Case identities and prior clinical correspondence flags were disclosed.

observations.sagittal: 6/7 show grossly compatible knee contours across contrasts with different displayed source counts. Series7 is relatively dark in these normalized samples.
observations.coronal_axial: Coronal4/5 show concordant gross femorotibial anatomy with fibular-region anatomy toward viewer-left in both posterior samples. Axial3 is compatible transverse knee anatomy; sparse levels are not used for a decisive independent fibular-side assignment.
observations.set_assessment: Fifteen samples favor one coherent main knee protocol. They do not establish both sides described by the two complete Greek report blocks. LiteralRIGHTcaptions are preserved without named anatomical-side proof, automatic block selection or clinical label acceptance.
observations.display_quality: Knee structures are present in all selected panels. Several fat-suppressed samples are relatively dark but not gross blank half-rasters. No wrong body region or clinical disease diagnosis inferred.
